name: klipin
description: Make faceless YouTube videos with the Klipin Chrome extension: title, script, voice, scenes, Google Flow images, MP4 render, YouTube pack & thumbnail.
long_description: Connects your AI agent to the Klipin Chrome extension running on this computer. Keep Chrome open with the Klipin panel (click the Klipin icon) — the agent can then write the script, sync scenes to the voice-over, generate images in Google Flow, render the MP4 and prepare titles, description, tags and a thumbnail. Everything runs locally; API keys stay inside the extension.

tools.name: klipin_status
tools.description: Show the current Klipin project: title, script, audio, scenes/prompts/images, YouTube pack, Flow tab connection and which AI providers are configured. Call this first.

tools.name: klipin_options
tools.description: List valid ids for content formats, narration styles, visual styles, aspect ratios, durations and TTS voices.

tools.name: klipin_new_project
tools.description: Start a new empty project (clears title, script, audio, scenes and images; keeps language/style preferences).

tools.name: klipin_titles
tools.description: Generate 5 catchy YouTube title options from a raw idea and select the first one.

tools.name: klipin_write_script
tools.description: Write the voice-over script with AI from the title (or set your own script with `script`). Returns the script.

tools.name: klipin_voice
tools.description: Generate the voice-over directly via a TTS API (Gemini / OpenAI / ElevenLabs key needed in Klipin settings). Alternative: the user makes it for free in Google AI Studio and you load the file with klip

tools.name: klipin_load_audio
tools.description: Load a voice-over audio file (wav/mp3/m4a/…) from this computer into the project, e.g. a file the user downloaded from Google AI Studio.

tools.name: klipin_scenes
tools.description: Trim silences, split the narration into timed scenes synced to the audio, and write an image prompt per scene. Replaces existing scenes.

tools.name: klipin_edit_scene
tools.description: Change the image prompt of one scene (then call klipin_images with that scene to regenerate it).

tools.name: klipin_images
tools.description: Generate scene images in Google Flow (the user must have a Flow project open in Chrome). Long-running: returns a job_id if not finished — then call klipin_wait.

tools.name: klipin_render
tools.description: Render the final MP4 (images + voice-over + subtitles) and save it to the Downloads/Klipin folder. Long-running: may return a job_id — then call klipin_wait.

tools.name: klipin_youtube
tools.description: Create the YouTube upload pack: 5 titles, description with auto chapters/timestamps and hashtags, tags, thumbnail text ideas and a thumbnail background prompt.

tools.name: klipin_thumbnail
tools.description: Compose a YouTube thumbnail sized to the project ratio (16:9 1280x720, 9:16 1080x1920, 1:1 1080x1080), save it as JPG to Downloads/Klipin and return a preview.

tools.name: klipin_youtube_attach
tools.description: Put the last rendered MP4 (kind video) or thumbnail (kind image) into the open file picker of the YouTube Studio upload dialog in Chrome. Upload and scheduling are then finished in Studio.

tools.name: klipin_wait
tools.description: Wait (up to ~50 s) for a long-running job (images, render, voice) and report its progress/result.
